Class EcsEncoder

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer>
io.jstach.rainbowgum.json.encoder.EcsEncoder
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogEncoder
public final class EcsEncoder extends LogEncoder.AbstractEncoder<JsonBuffer>
A JSON encoder in Elastic Common Schema (ECS) logging format.

Two shapes are supported, controlled by structured():

  • Flattened (default): field names are the flattened, dotted ECS field names (e.g. "log.level") rather than nested JSON objects, matching how the reference ecs-logging-java implementation serializes them.
  • Structured (structured=true): fields are nested JSON objects (e.g. "log":{"level":...}), matching Spring Boot's ECS structured logging format.
MDC / key values have no reserved ECS field in either shape, so - like both reference implementations - they are written as top-level fields using their own key name. This means a key value whose name collides with a reserved ECS field name (e.g. message) will overwrite it; that footgun exists in the reference implementations too.
